mentions.name: Coding tool
mentions.description: A coding tool in development; current work focuses on its onboarding experience, deciding which features to highlight to new users landing on the website without overwhelming them.
mentions.source_excerpt: Working on figuring out onboarding for my coding tool. For someone who has been baked into building I'm struggling to put myself into the position of a new user just landing on the website.
